prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original logo concept for AIpollo, an AI research and learning companion that connects academic sources with trustworthy understanding.
Style: professional restrained contemporary graphic identity; flat vector-like solid shapes, exceptional geometric craft, optical balance, very clean edges, no texture, no 3D, no shadows, no gradients, no glow.
Palette: deep navy #102A43 and sunlight gold #F4B544 only. Genuinely transparent background, no white rectangle, no checkerboard drawn into image.
Composition: a single centered HORIZONTAL logo lockup, generous transparent margins, compact symbol on the LEFT and the exact wordmark AIpollo on the RIGHT. Wordmark in a sophisticated medium-bold humanist geometric sans serif, navy, precise letterspacing, friendly but authoritative. Capital A, capital I, lowercase p o l l o: "AIpollo". Icon height about 1.5 times wordmark cap height. Large enough to judge fine craft, no unnecessary blank expanse.
Constraints: icon must stay recognizable at 24-32px; robust shapes and open gaps, not hairlines. Name exactly AIpollo once, no slogan, no captions, no concept name, no mockup objects, no other text. Avoid generic atom diagram, neural-network node clutter, rockets, stars, brains, books, generic AI sparkle. Original logo, not NASA insignia or another existing brand.
Primary concept: ORBITAL A. Design an unmistakable upright abstract capital A as a confident navy geometric monogram, open triangular counter. A SINGLE elegantly tilted gold orbital sweep wraps across and around the A, with just one modest gold circular discovery point on the orbit, integrated with the sweep rather than decorative floating clutter. Controlled front/back overlap in flat color with clear negative-space separations. Create a distinctive compact silhouette, warm curious intelligence and exploratory motion. A remains readable. Just one orbit, no multiple atom loops.
